Native Quest 3 VR/MR development preview. **Tested only on Quest 3; other headsets are not guaranteed. The project remains in active development.**

### Changes since 0.9.1

- Control Jackie on scanned room surfaces with Touch: left stick movement, right trigger jump, A/B punches/kicks and right grip roll.
- Change extracted Jackie's reference height with right stick up/down: 5–156.6 cm, default 10 cm.
- Keep the original level running while Jackie is outside; isolate the hidden original player from movement and combat.
- Fix close-camera characters being cut by the clapperboard plane while preserving authored camera framing.
- Fix false gameplay pauses when one Touch profile/stick temporarily becomes unavailable. Remaining controls stay usable; only sustained loss of both controllers activates automatic protection.
- Correct the MR roll animation, remove the redundant MR window-size menu, and show current SCENE and death/retry TAKE on the clapperboard.
- Make hand tracking and window editing exclusive to the shared interaction mode; improve switching back to Touch.

### Installation

Download the APK attached below. Enable Developer Mode and install with ADB. The APK uses the same stable sideload signature as earlier preview builds.

**You must supply your own legally obtained Jackie Chan Stuntmaster NTSC-U disc image (SLUS-00684). No disc image, extracted game data, levels, models, audio or movies are included in the APK or source distribution.**

Follow the [English installation guide](https://github.com/Yurgil/ReChan-VR-Standalone/blob/v0.10.4/docs/quest/INSTALL.md) or [инструкцию на русском](https://github.com/Yurgil/ReChan-VR-Standalone/blob/v0.10.4/docs/quest/INSTALL_RU.md). Check the APK against the attached SHA256SUMS.

This is an experimental preview: full-game testing, MR interaction and performance validation remain ongoing. The input-pause fix has automated regression coverage; broader headset acceptance is still in progress.
